results: The EXISTING classical Hill root, primitive and source-continuation domain are DEFINITIONALLY the shared TracePrimitiveFamily construction. Restriction of the actual continuous physical circle potential to the unit interval is a bounded complex linear map, retaining the original unit-interval normalization.

The ACTUAL continuous Fourier coefficient realization has EXACTLY the original physical L2 Hill trace. Shared trace-family functoriality identifies the ENTIRE source-continuation domain and ACTUAL continued primitive under this realization, with NO extra square-root sign or logarithm period. This transfers the verified classical physical sheet sign to the actual physical L2 primitive for continuous inputs.

Shared continuous Fourier synthesis is POINTWISE real whenever its ACTUAL raw coefficients obey conjugate reflection. The finite H-minus-one density approximants have continuous real physical representatives with EXACTLY the original doubled L2 coefficients. No potential, Fourier index, physical period, normalization, or H-minus-one norm is substituted.

The EXACT original finite Fourier truncations converge to EVERY real native unit-period H-minus-one potential in the H-minus-one norm. Their physical L2/continuous primitive signs pass by the ACTUAL joint analytic primitive continuity to a nonnegative half-plane sign. The approximants need NO uniform L2 norm bound or additional regularity.

Shared maximum modulus proves strictness: if an analytic primitive has nonnegative real part and2*cosh(primitive) is a nonconstant ENTIRE trace, its real part is STRICTLY positive. Applied to the ACTUAL Hill trace, its already proved nonconstancy excludes equality. No additional spectral sign, self-adjointness claim or zero-separation hypothesis is supplied.

For EVERY original native REAL unit-period H-minus-one potential q and EVERY energy with nonzero imaginary part, the ACTUAL free-normalized primitive satisfies Im(lambda)*Re(F(lambda,q))>0. In particular it has STRICTLY POSITIVE real part on the ENTIRE upper energy half-plane and STRICTLY NEGATIVE real part on the ENTIRE lower half-plane. There is NO high-energy, mean-zero, smallness or open-gap restriction.

For EVERY original positive n, the purely imaginary shift F+i*n*pi has the SAME strict real-part sign. Its exact square identity now determines the ACTUAL physical sheet: F+i*n*pi=+principalSqrt(K) above the real axis, and F+i*n*pi=-principalSqrt(K) below it. hillHminus_whole_disc_square_physical_sheets applies to EVERY actual filled square family used by the previous intrinsic joint normalization, and to EVERY real input in its original complex neighborhood.

The actual shifted-primitive sheet ambiguity on the nonreal high discs is NOW RESOLVED. The upper/lower real-gap boundary limits, original contour-action/gap-integral identification, normalized action-to-gap-square extension, actual KdV Birkhoff map and original smooth-approximation KdV flow remain UNPROVED. ALL FIVE MAIN theorems remain OPEN; goal ACTIVE.

TracePrimitiveFamily functoriality preserves the ACTUAL root and primitive, including their exact sign and additive logarithm normalization.
source_correspondence.approximation: Literal symmetric finite Fourier truncations converge in the ACTUAL H-minus-one norm. Their real continuous physical realizations have exactly the doubled L2 coefficients of the original approximants; no uniform L2 bound is assumed.
source_correspondence.global_sign: FOR EVERY lambda with Im(lambda) nonzero: Im(lambda)*Re(F(lambda,q))>0. The strict upper/lower signs are proved from continuous approximation plus maximum modulus and NONCONSTANCY of the ACTUAL entire Hill trace.
source_correspondence.high_square: For EVERY actual K satisfying its PROVED continued-primitive matching identity on a full high disc, F+i*n*pi=+principalSqrt(K) when Im(lambda)>0, and-principalSqrt(K) when Im(lambda)<0. This holds for EVERY REAL input in the original COMPLEX potential neighborhood and includes discs with collapsed gaps.
